newsitem.title: FRANCE: Forecast - Bank of France seen holding rates.
newsitem.headline: Forecast - Bank of France seen holding rates.

text.p: The Bank of France's monetary policy council is likely to hold rates unchanged when it next meets on Thursday, according to a Reuters poll.

Ten out of 15 economists polled on Tuesday said they expected the intervention rate, which sets the floor for French money market rates, to remain at 3.10 percent, although most said there was room for further easing at some stage.

Five said they were expecting a five basis point cut on Thursday, citing the recent strength of the franc as one justification for a reduction.The franc was trading late on Tuesday around 3.3648 per mark, close to a 46-month high.
The intervention rate was last cut from 3.15 percent on January 30.
